area: Keystone testbed: camera_shaker composes the damage jolt

find.report_claim: cycle 142 adopted keystone.camera_shake for deterministic trauma noise and claimed the game composes the offset onto its own pose; the shooter as Keystone testbed should consume the module that owns that composition
find.live_evidence: camera_shaker was one of 21 Keystone modules the shooter never imported; _sync_scene hand-wrote cam.position = eye + offset.position plus yaw and pitch composition
find.consumer_evidence: CameraShaker.pose() returns a new PerspectiveCamera from an immutable base pose and camera_shaker_report exposes base vs shaken pose, both absent from the shooter

killed: replacing camera_shake_report: test_hurt_shake pins its trauma key, so the richer report must be additive
using the scene camera as the shaker base: the previous frame's jolt would feed back into the base every frame
keeping the hand composition alongside the shaker: two owners would drift silently
analyze.survivor: a separate base PerspectiveCamera refreshed from the sim pose each non-cinematic frame, CameraShaker.pose() for the rendered camera, and an additive camera_shaker_report

fix.shooter: shooter/game.py imports PerspectiveCamera/CameraShaker/camera_shaker_report, owns a base camera and shaker next to CameraShake, composes through the shaker, clears the new report on rebuild and on both cinematic starts, and keeps the existing camera_shake_report shape; tests/test_keystone_camera_shaker_mechanics.py (5 tests) pins pose equality, base immutability, the base-vs-pose report, sim isolation and the clears; README testbed matrix and tree name the consumer and test

shooter.caught_during_implementation: the first run of test_build_scene_and_a_cinematic_clear_the_shaker_report failed with a live report behind the death cinematic; both cinematic starts were then taught to clear it
shooter.mutation: reverting the shaker composition to the old hand-added offset fails test_the_rendered_camera_is_the_shaker_pose and test_the_base_pose_stays_on_the_sim_eye_across_frames; game.py restored byte-identically (sha256 284b49c1405f27e2d2608df047ed3dcab9653aff6cce3ebe1e23fc6b6ee8d682)
shooter.isolation: sim snapshot hash unchanged across shaker pose sampling; cinematics still own the camera and clear all shake reports
shooter.codebase_map: regenerated after the new Keystone imports
